[Hologram] Great. Remember, your flashlight will lose power over time, so switch it off when you don't need it. When the flashlight is off, it will recharge itself.

[Hologram] Moving around in your armor may be a little tricky at first. Take a moment to get a feel for moving around. Once you get comfortable with this, proceed to the next section just around the corner.
[Hologram] Nice work.

While moving forward, jump up and hold the jump button to go into a crouch in mid-air. It may be tricky at first, but you'll find it comes in handy to be able to jump and duck into tight areas.

[Hologram] If you can't push an obstacle out of the way, you might try pulling it. To pull a box, move up to it and press your use key. While holding down the use key, move backwards and the box will be pulled with you.
[Hologram] What you really need to do is push the box down into the pit. Pushing is easy, just move forward into the box and you can push it into position.
